text:
marta: Hey — staging build shows broken nav when linking to guide fragments. Link ends up as /guides#Installing%20The%20Agent which doesn't match our heading slug.

josh: Can you paste the failing link + the small chunk of the build log?

marta: Sure — here's the link and the output from linkcheck:

`/guides/agent-setup#Installing%20The%20Agent`

Build log snippet:
```
WARN: Fragment '/guides/agent-setup#Installing%20The%20Agent' not found (route /guides/agent-setup)
ERROR: Linkcheck failed: 1 broken fragment
```

elaine: Ah — looks like an MDX snippet generated the heading with explicit text that the slugger turned into 'installing-the-agent' while the link was generated by a script that URL-encodes spaces. Two possible fixes: normalize the fragment generator to slugify (preferred), or decode URL-encoded fragments during link resolution.

ben: I can open a tiny patch for the first option. Quick plan: update the link generation script to run the same slugify util we use in Docusaurus, and add a unit test. I'll push a draft PR.

marta: Nice. If we do fallback decoding we should add it as a safety net in mkdocs/docusaurus, but prefer canonical slugs for perf.

docs-bot: CI | docs-build (staging) #784 failed on linkcheck — 1 broken fragment

josh: Draft PR looks good. For the unit test include these cases: spaces, percent-encoded, and bracket characters. e.g.
```
'Installing The Agent' -> 'installing-the-agent'
'Installing%20The%20Agent' -> 'installing-the-agent'
'Agent [v2]' -> 'agent-v2'
```

ben: Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 — includes slugify call + tests. CI running.

elaine: I retested locally with the patched generator, nav now resolves. :raised_hands: Merge once CI is green.

marta: Thanks all — defangging this for release tomorrow. I'll watch the staging build.

docs-bot: CI | docs-build (staging) #784 success — linkcheck passed

ben: Merged. :shipit:
